descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name with theophoric element meaning 'YHWH is my light,' appearing in two orthographic variants: the short form אוּרִיָּה (Uriyah, 36x) and the long form אוּרִיָּהוּ (Uriyahu, 2x). English 'Uriah / Uriyah / Uriyahu,' Spanish 'Urías / Uriyahu,' Hindi 'ऊरिय्याह / ऊरिय्याहू,' Arabic 'أُورِيّا / أُورِيَّا,' Korean '우리야 / 우리야가,' Swahili 'Uria / Uriya.' The two clusters reflect only the well-known -yah/-yahu alternation in Hebrew theophoric names; the referent(s) are identical across both forms.
